$comment: Provenance and adoption map for this starter. `pnpm adopt` reads the groups below and records under `adoption` what it removed (the groups chosen by flag), when, and the starter commit the project started from (`starterRevision`); a group without a flag is removed by every adoption run. `adoption: null` means this is the starter itself; once set, it is a product built from it (see AGENTS.md). Keep this file in adopted projects.

demo.description: Starter-only demo: DemoHub start page, demo auth adapter, public onboarding preview, the demo build and its GitHub Pages deployment.

reference.description: The Resource reference feature: feature module, route, navigation entry, mock API and copy.

maintenance.description: Checks that only the starter can pass: the adoption check's `pnpm verify` step and CI job. Removed by every adoption run; `pnpm adopt:check` then refuses to run.
